- FRONT VIEW: "6.90 +0.06/-0.02" (receptacle opening width); "1.85 +0.08/-0.02" (opening height); "6.60" (leg centres); "0.60".
- TOP VIEW: "4.75±0.10"; "7.86Ref." (overall, flange tip to flange tip); "0.45Ref.".
- REAR VIEW: "6.30" (inner faces of the legs).
- BOTTOM VIEW: "5.10±0.15" (front face to rear terminal tails); "2.15±0.15" (front face to the shell-leg centreline); "2.60±0.10"; "1.30±0.10"; "0.24±0.08".
- REFERANCE PCB LAYOUT, "SCALE 1:2(TOLERANCE:±0.05)": "PCB END" line; "1.45" (PCB END to slot centreline); "3.35" (slot centreline to rear end of the signal pads); "1.35" (signal pad length); "0.40"; "1.30"; "2.60"; "4.80"; "8.00"; "4.30"; "6.10"; "0.50"; "0.90"; "1.20"; "1.60"; "1.40"; "0.25".
- Title block: "tolerances unless otherwise specified ... linear 0.X±0.30, 0.XX±0.20, 0.XXX±0.10"; "angles 0°±2°".
- Note 6: "PART NUMBER: 10118193-000 X LF, 1- WHIT FLANGE, 2- WITHOUT FLANGE" (WHIT is the drawing's spelling). So -0001LF is the flanged version.
parts.notes:
AXES: body_length is the long side along the board edge, which is also the direction of the pin row (5 pins at 0.65 pitch). body_width is the depth along the plug insertion axis, perpendicular to the edge.

HEIGHT
- The drawing dimensions "2.7" from the seating plane to the top of the latch tab. It carries no tolerance of its own, so the general 0.X±0.30 applies: maximum 3.0 mm.
- Scaled from the vector geometry, the shell top surface is 2.50 mm above the PCB. The flange's top edge is the highest point at 2.80 mm.
- The flange's bottom edge is 0.30 mm BELOW the PCB top surface. That is only possible because the flange sits beyond the board edge.
- "3.10Ref." is the flange's full vertical span (+2.80 to -0.30). Distributors quote this 3.1 mm as the part's "height", but it is not the height above the board.
- The shell legs go 0.80 mm below the seating plane, through the plated slots.

DEPTH (body_width)
- Side view: "5.05±0.30" from the body front face to the rear of the shell, so 5.35 maximum.
- Bottom view: "5.10±0.15" from the front face to the rear terminal tails, so 5.25 maximum.
- Including the flange, the nominal overall depth is 5.05 + 0.60 = 5.65 mm.

WIDTH (body_length)
- The outer shell width is NOT dimensioned. It scales to 7.50 mm, and the top and front views agree; the scale was checked against "4.75±0.10", "7.86Ref." and "6.90".
- The overall maximum is "7.86Ref.", measured across the flange tips at the front corners. In the front view those tips sit about 1.6 to 1.8 mm above the board.
- "6.90 +0.06/-0.02" is only the receptacle OPENING, not the outside of the shell.
- The existing footprint note "Mech3 body ... y +-3.45" uses 6.90, which is too narrow. Use ±3.75 for the shell and ±3.93 for the flange tips.

FLANGE (scaled)
- A frame around the mouth: top edge about 5.90 mm wide at +2.80, bottom edge about 4.50 mm wide at -0.30, and side tips at 7.86 Ref.
- The top and bottom tips stand 0.60 Ref / 0.61 Ref forward of the body front face. The side tips stand 0.45 Ref forward of where the side walls end (top view).

POSITION RELATIVE TO THE PCB EDGE
- The layout puts the slot / shell-leg centreline 1.45 behind the "PCB END" line (layout tolerance ±0.05).
- The bottom view puts the body front face 2.15±0.15 in front of that centreline. So the body front face is 0.70 mm OUTSIDE the PCB END line (0.55 to 0.85 within tolerance).
- The top and bottom flange tips are 0.70 + 0.60 = 1.30 mm outside it (1.31 at the bottom tip).
- The signal pad centres are 1.45 + 3.35 - 1.35/2 = 4.125 mm inside the PCB END line.
- The rear of the shell is 5.05 - 0.70 = 4.35 mm inside it (4.40 to the tail ends by 5.10; 4.65 at 5.35 max).

FOOTPRINT-LOCAL COORDINATES (origin = pin 3 pad centre, mouth toward -x)
- PCB END: x = -4.125.
- Body front face: x = -4.825.
- Top and bottom flange tips: x = -5.425.
- Shell rear: x = +0.225 nominal, +0.525 at the 5.35 maximum.
- Shell: y = ±3.75 (scaled). Flange tips: y = ±3.93.
- Height: z = 0 to 3.0 maximum. The flange alone reaches -0.30 below the board surface, beyond the edge only.
- This agrees with the board note: maker's PCB END line on the board edge, body overhanging 0.70 mm, flange 1.30 mm.
